scripts.build: svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && vite build && node ../../scripts/finalize-static-headers.mjs
scripts.build:e2e: svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && vite build --mode e2e && node ../../scripts/finalize-static-headers.mjs
scripts.test: vitest run src --exclude src/app/App.client.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.client.config.ts
scripts.coverage: vitest run src --exclude src/app/App.client.test.ts --coverage --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage/node --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=55 --coverage.thresholds.functions=65 --coverage.thresholds.lines=65 && vitest run --config vitest.client.config.ts --coverage --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage/client --coverage.thresholds.statements=60 --coverage.thresholds.branches=40 --coverage.thresholds.functions=65 --coverage.thresholds.lines=50 --testTimeout=20000
